# Containment requirement inventory (#452)

<!-- Generated from docs/security/containment-inventory.json and docs/security/containment-scenarios.json: go test ./internal/containmentinv -run TestCommittedInventory -update-inventory. Do not edit. -->

This inventory is a declaration. Each row names a #452 requirement, its status, the layer that evidences it, the exact test leaves and assertion sites or the artifacts behind it, and the profiles on which its refs are mandatory. An AST lint binds every ref to a `// containment: <ID>` marker inside the cited function. The inventory never shows observed results: each checker run publishes those separately, bound to the tested source.

A row backed by containment scenarios takes its status from the scenario registry's declared outcome (docs/security/containment.md); the registry is the only owner of scenario outcomes. Statuses: `verified`, `uncontained(<owner>)`, `pending(<owner>)`, `unobserved(<profile>)`, `out-of-scope(<reason>)`.
